study type: Prospective study (with a retrospective control group)
exposure: Placenta previa with sonographic adherence findings
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies who underwent cesarean section for placenta previa with sonographic adherence findings
finding: Intraoperative wireless ultrasonography during cesarean delivery for placenta previa with sonographic adherence findings significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss and shortened hospital stay.
mod_finding: The use of intraoperative wireless ultrasonography was significantly associated with reduced massive intraoperative hemorrhage.
